vo_open.text: In 1986, three minutes next to this could kill you.

vo.text: The Elephant's Foot: melted nuclear fuel, sand and concrete, under Chernobyl.
vo.cap: *The Elephant's Foot.* Melted fuel, sand, concrete. *Chernobyl.*

vo.text: It was found eight months after the disaster, in December 1986.
It gave off up to ten thousand roentgens an hour. A lethal dose in about three minutes.
vo.cap: Up to *10,000 roentgens/hour.* Lethal in about *3 minutes.*

vo.text: Its most famous photo was taken with an automatic camera.
It's weaker today. But still dangerous.
Would you stand next to it for ten seconds? Tell me in the comments. And subscribe for more.

cta.q: Would you stand there for 10 seconds?
